To install, download **ModSyncUpdate.apk** below and open it on your phone. Only download it from this official Releases page. No Steam login is needed for most mods (anonymous mode); if you do log in, your password is never stored, only a login token stays on the device. If something goes wrong, open **LOG** in the app and send the exported log so it can be fixed. © 2026 Ronald, all rights reserved. ModSync Update is not affiliated with Valve or Steam.
